description: This file defines classes and templates related to data framing, including fixed-size integer types (SInt24, UInt24), a generic FrameType class with nested Reader and Writer classes for serialization/deserialization, and utility functions for handling variable-length encoding and endianness. It appears to be part of a core library for data serialization within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: SInt24
classes.description: Represents a 24-bit signed integer with serialization support.

classes.name: UInt24
classes.description: Represents a 24-bit unsigned integer with serialization support.

classes.name: FrameType
classes.description: A templated class for handling data frames with serialization/deserialization capabilities, supporting configurable block size and endianness. Contains nested Reader and Writer classes for reading from and writing to frames.

methods.name: RealSize
methods.description: Template function to determine the real size of a type or class, considering a static SizeOf member if present.
